title: Liam Coen: I was told ball switched hands on Parker Washington catch

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Liam Coen: I was told ball switched hands on Parker Washington catch
sources.description: The Giants held off the Jaguars on Sunday, but the outcome might have been different if referees had made a different ruling on a pass to Jaguars wideout Parker Washington early in the fourth quarter.
